sources.entry: Desktop Wallpaper Switcher - Win / Linux / macOS tool for managing and cycling desktop wallpapers.

summary.one_liner: A Qt-based desktop tool that cycles wallpapers at a set interval, with a wallpaper list manager and an image browser for sorting and deleting images.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a cross-platform tool for rotating the desktop wallpaper at a regular interval. It includes a wallpaper list manager for organizing the images in the rotation. It also has a simple image browser for quickly going through large collections of wallpapers and deleting ones you don't want. Building is described as straightforward on Windows with Qt installed, supporting both Qt 4 and Qt 5 in 32- and 64-bit builds. The README states that only a Windows release is downloadable. It also notes that setting the wallpaper is not yet implemented on Mac and Linux, though the UI and cycling logic are said to work there.
use_cases: rotate desktop wallpaper automatically on a timer
sort through a large folder of wallpapers
manage a playlist of wallpapers for the desktop
how_to_run: Build the project from source (README says this is straightforward on Windows)
Or download the latest release for Windows from the link in the README
notable: Wallpaper cycling at a regular interval
Simple image browser for sifting and deleting wallpapers
caveats: Wallpaper setting is not implemented on Mac OS X or Linux yet
Building from source relies on having Qt installed
